url.label: Site to rebuild (yours, or you have permission)

steps.title: Confirm you may rebuild it
steps.gate_summary: Approve only if you own {{inputs.url}} or have permission to rebuild it. Reject cancels the run.

steps.title: Capture the original
steps.prompt: Open {{inputs.url}} in your browser pane. Screenshot every page section at 390, 768 and 1280 px wide into {{run.dir}}/original/. Record computed styles and the hover, scroll and click states in {{run.dir}}/capture.md. Name the page sections in order.

steps.title: Extract tokens and assets
steps.prompt: From {{run.dir}}/capture.md write {{run.dir}}/tokens.md: fonts, colours, spacing scale and global styles. Download the images, icons and fonts the page uses into {{run.dir}}/assets/.

steps.title: Write one spec per section
steps.prompt: Group the sections in {{run.dir}}/capture.md into four parts in page order. Write {{run.dir}}/section-0.md to section-3.md, one per part, with exact CSS values from {{run.dir}}/tokens.md, every state, and each breakpoint.

steps.title: Build each part
steps.prompt: Build the part described in {{run.dir}}/section-{{index}}.md as {{inputs.stack}} components in this worktree, using {{run.dir}}/tokens.md and the files in {{run.dir}}/assets/. Touch only that part's own files. Commit on the current branch. Do not push.

steps.title: Merge and wire the page
steps.prompt: Merge these branches into the current branch in order: {{steps.sections.outputs.branch}}. Resolve conflicts, wire the four parts into one page, and make `npm run dev -- --port <n>` serve it. Stop any server you start before you finish; the workbench serves it. Commit. Do not push.

steps.title: Fix the drift
steps.prompt: If {{run.dir}}/diff.md exists, fix every region it lists in this folder and commit. If it does not exist yet, change nothing. Set fixed to how many regions you fixed.

steps.title: Pixel-diff against the original
steps.prompt: The rebuilt page is open in your browser pane. Screenshot it at 390, 768 and 1280 px and pixel-diff each against {{run.dir}}/original/. Write {{run.dir}}/diff.md listing every region more than 2% different, with breakpoint and position. Set verdict to pass when no region is listed, otherwise drift.
